absorbed_bugs.summary: .tool-versions no longer grants mise auto-ownership; shared marker ownership is deterministic.
Python source audit closes extensionless-script file handles.
direnv absent/blocked/authorized states are distinct and never auto-trusted.
asdf plugin provenance is credential/query/fragment safe.
Requested asdf versions cannot masquerade as observed current versions.
Provider identity verification detects path drift, disappearance and same-path content replacement.
Go provider qualification occurs before effective toolchain evidence; system Go is not recorded for provider-owned execution.
toolchain doctor reports asdf/pyenv selection truthfully.
asdf plugin IDs are distinct from executable IDs, including golang -> go.
asdf current output supports version-first and plugin+version shapes.
Composition-provider identity no longer falsely implies Python/Go runtime ownership for unrelated tools.
asdf/pyenv system pass-through preserves system runtime ownership.
pyenv now records PYENV_DIR/legacy-file/source provenance and fails on requested-vs-active mismatch.
ASDF_DIR/ASDF_DATA_DIR now reject invalid relative configuration and participate in provider provenance.
Provider post-qualification re-verification now uses the authoritative parent/config/spec execution environment instead of treating CommandSpec.env as the whole process environment.
ASDF_<TOOL>_VERSION overrides now participate in canonical selected-tool/runtime ownership even without a version file and remain subject to observed-current qualification.

consumed_upstream_authority.ENV-P029: Protected Devtool runtime namespace authority is delivered by ENV-X01; X02 consumes and regression-proves it without creating a competing authority.
